name: flow_agent_images
description: Hand up to 50 image scenes to Flow's own Agent mode, which renders them all in parallel (about a minute for a whole batch) and enriches each prompt itself. Images only, 0 credits. Less exact than flow_generate: the agent picks the wording, no techniques/reference images, and file order is best-effort. Use flow_generate when every scene needs exact settings. Returns a job id; use flow_wait.

project.description: Folder name for the downloaded images.

scenes.description: One image description per scene, in order.
